title: AC1027 DXF compact default MATERIAL graph exact raw replay
status: bounded compact raw-only graph implementation; no general MATERIAL support claim

authority.scope: MATERIAL group 72 occurs in both diffuse and normal map contexts; group 94 carries channel flags. The abbreviated body is kept raw, without choosing a group-72 meaning.

source: An in-tree-authored DXF was converted to AC1027 DWG by ODA File Converter 27.1 and back to DXF. The ODA-returned source has root C → ACAD_MATERIAL dictionary 67, owner/reactor C; entries ByBlock→69, ByLayer→68, Global→6A. Each MATERIAL has owner/reactor 67 and exactly AcDbMaterial, name, 72=1, 94=127. The selected input retains the exact four subordinate records and only the ACAD_MATERIAL root entry. The projection is authored from producer output, not a producer-authored standalone drawing. ODA conversion lineage is a manually observed join, not established by hashes.
change: Recognize only this exact AC1027 compact producer body through the existing explicit sparse-material raw facet. Preserve 72 only in raw and clear diffuse-source presence because the sparse body cannot distinguish its role. The raw-only marker continues to refuse generic typed DXF and DWG output. For adapter output, reconcile the immutable import baseline and raw groups exactly, decode the unambiguous prefix and require complete typed/common equality, then use existing source-receipt, unique NOD/dictionary/owner/reactor/target graph, target-reference, and staged raw-output checks. Existing 94=63 sparse bodies remain refused by the adapter.
tests: Generated ASCII/Binary tests cover old consumer and non-opted-in subclass refusal, enabled facet, direct typed DXF/DWG refusal, copy/move marker, three owner/reactor and raw handle-role mutations, raw body, typed values and unsupported semantic-state mutation, missing typed/raw records, duplicate/aliased entries and root, malformed/extra/duplicate groups and adjacent version, staged typed/raw mutations, sentinel preservation, same-adapter retries and target-version refusal. Both new and old sparse-material CTests pass. The selected physical graph passes those tests and strict CLI ASCII/Binary output plus Binary→ASCII repeat. The independent pinned ezdxf audit checks source projection, all raw 72/94 values, dictionary/material identities and owner/reactor graph; no errors/fixes. A malformed immutable raw-values vector is rejected before any suffix access; 94=63 remains an explicit adapter refusal in both encodings.
limits: This is exact same-version AC1027 DXF transport, not DWG-origin MATERIAL qualification or native rendering/meaning.
Raw-only callbacks are explicitly opt-in; typed defaults and the raw-only marker must not be mistaken for complete material semantics.
The full ODA-returned source is still refused at SECTIONOBJECT proxy graphics handle 0x33 and preserves the destination; removing that record exposes a separate SECTIONMANAGER preflight failure.
The earlier 94=63 sparse-material profile remains raw-only and is not admitted by this adapter route.
No claim that channel values 63 and 127 are semantically equivalent.
The source projection and output are separate files under /private/tmp; no repository fixture is added.

integrated_validation: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_dxf_(compact_material_graph|sparse_material_raw)$' --output-on-failure: 2/2 passed; combined-branch CLI strict selected graph export succeeded.
